title: Route the SignalInbox's .tick/ commits through the repository publisher, or prove the disjointness
body: The SignalInbox commit queue (tracker-write.ts) writes to the repository without holding the publish slot; today its paths are disjoint from the run branch's records and it has its own in-DO queue, so the boundary is safe but stated only in prose in repo-room's header. A later phase tick should either route those commits through RepoRoom.publish or add a test proving the namespace disjointness, so 'every publish to a repository goes through one serialized publisher' stops having a prose exception.
